title: Showing some updates to Conquest Online, a free to play crossplay web based mmorpg
author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
selftext:
latest patch includes newer camera orbit, movement, gem socketing, world pvp and working dueling/multiplayer. 

Workflow includes Replit (Heavy  Claude UI at the moment) + Gemini for custom UI which I have ready made but want to ***ensure all functionality work before polishing the UI***

If youd like to check it out let me know, I dont want the post to come off as spam with the link

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body:
As you can see in this demo I got attacked before I could show yall the socketing and panicked and ended recording lol but there are about 1-2 slots per items that drop in the 3 newer level 10+ zones

Serpents Reach

Phoe Outpost (jeweller and upgrader)

Frozen Peak (world pvp)

comments.author: TheKaleKing
comments.body:
Really nice! What is it made with? Three js? Also, are all the 3d models generated by code with claude/gemini or did you use some external software like [Meshy.ai](http://Meshy.ai) or something like that?

Really cool, love the art style.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
I really appreciate it! I have another game with custom meshy models before they went Meshy 5 which does not allow me to download my models glb anymore :( so I am looking for a rig replacement currently

  
These models were all generated internally. I havent updated any UI or models as of yet with any customs until I can get the skeleton of the game done

ty for your feedback

replies.author: TheKaleKing
replies.body:
You're welcome! 😄 Ohh really cool. I didn't know they didn't support glb though unfortunate. That game that you showed in this post above, which engine is it made in if any?

I've been thinking of making a simple 3d game that you can play in the browser. I usually do unity but I wonder if something simpler could work too and could work better with AI so I'm curious what it's made with.

Great job though thanks for sharing your other game too that character screen reminds me of WoW haha.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
that other title, NE Online, I am building with base44, similar to replit/ Building the game engine so I can import my custom models, they do not natively take glb or other file formats

ty vm! I took WoW as an inspiration
